objective: Extract a deterministic fitted realization of the two scalar interaction bits in a structurally frozen REL_INC coordinate gauge, so their support can be inspected for sparse or repeated structural motifs.
extraction_rule: Build all frozen REL_INC pair columns and exact affine columns.
Order REL_INC pair columns lexicographically before exact affine columns.
Use deterministic highest-index GF(2) row pivots, which gives affine columns priority.
Set all free variables to zero.
Back-substitute to obtain one canonical coefficient vector for y0 and one for y1.
anti_circularity: Column definitions and ordering do not depend on outcomes.
Outcome bits determine only the right-hand sides of the two solved systems.
The extracted supports are explicitly labeled fitted discovery objects, not promoted structural laws.
targets: pair-support size for y0 and y1
whether affine-control 3x7 naturally requires no interaction support
repeated REL_INC motifs suitable for a frozen next-round structural hypothesis
falsifiers: Any reconstruction failure invalidates the extraction harness.
If a carrier known to have target dimension two yields no pair support for a target bit, the basis/gauge implementation is inconsistent.
No support pattern is considered established until independently frozen and qualified.
next_if_sparse: Promote the simplest repeated structural motif to an outcome-independent syndrome candidate and qualify it on a fresh non-affine carrier.
next_if_dense: Factor the fitted support by predeclared REL_INC invariants and phase before proposing a structural syndrome.
